title: Indicate the use of artificial intelligence (AI)

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines
location.section: Indicate the use of artificial intelligence (AI)

slide_intent: Disclose synthetic or meaningfully altered content so viewers can understand how a representation was made.
strategic_value: Visible AI disclosure can help Helsinki make the provenance of its communications inspectable.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture states when AI disclosure applies and supplies two wording examples alongside watermark, text or audio methods.
practical_value: Check whether content is wholly AI-produced or altered enough to change meaning, then apply the stated disclosure methods.

content_islands.name: Disclosure condition
content_islands.spec: Place the fully generated or meaning-changing modification condition first.

content_islands.name: Marking methods and wording
content_islands.spec: Follow with watermark and text/audio instructions and the two sample statements.

reference_purposes.Application: The section gives disclosure methods and two sample statements.
reference_purposes.Constraint: It applies disclosure to wholly AI-created content or significant modification that changes meaning.
